id: title:TueHaulund:play back recording files exported with window uuids

review.posthog_relevance: Supports compatibility for session recording playback when importing/exported session recordings contain mixed window ID formats (UUIDs and integers), allowing the frontend to handle version-specific ID conversions.
review.reason: Adds a new exported function and its unit tests; P1.F2.H1 adds version-specific window ID conversion. This is a localized maintenance and compatibility improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on the existence of mixed-format exported recordings, which is not independently verified. No production incident or systemic risk reduction is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new exported function and its unit tests; P1.F2.H1 adds version-specific window ID conversion.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows session recording playback to handle mixed window ID formats (UUIDs and integers) depending on export version, supporting compatibility with older exported session recordings.
